description: Unit tests for per-resource destroy APIs (VAL-GPU-001 through VAL-GPU-006, VAL-GPU-011, VAL-GPU-013, VAL-GPU-014)

assertions.evidence: test_destroy_mesh in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — creates mesh, verifies count=1, removes it, verifies count=0 and get_mesh returns None. Exit code 0.
test_destroy_material in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — creates material, verifies count=1, removes it, verifies count=0 and get_material returns None. Exit code 0.

test_destroy_texture in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — verifies NONE handle detection and TextureHandle::new(u32::MAX) is_none guard. Full GPU test requires Vulkan context (logic-only test). Exit code 0.
test_destroy_skeleton in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — uses ResourceStorage to create/remove skeleton descriptor and buffer, verifies both empty after removal. Exit code 0.
test_double_destroy_safe in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — double remove_mesh and remove_material verified safe (first returns Some, second returns None, no panic). Exit code 0.
test_destroy_unowned_safe in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — remove_mesh/remove_material with NONE handle and MeshHandle::new(99999) all safe, no panic. Exit code 0.
test_default_textures_preserved in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — verifies default handle indices 0-4 are detected as non-NONE, protecting them from destruction. Exit code 0.

test_destroy_api_compiles in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — verifies destroy_mesh, destroy_material, destroy_texture, destroy_skeleton all compile and are callable on VulkanRenderer. cargo check -p katla_app succeeds. Exit code 0.

test_destroy_mesh and test_destroy_material in katla_gfx/src/renderer/destroy_api.rs — verify AssetRegistry.remove_mesh and remove_material return Option<T> with correct values, enabling GPU cleanup. test_mesh_count_create_destroy_sequence and test_material_count_create_destroy_sequence verify slot recycling. Exit code 0.

commandsRun: cargo test -p katla_gfx -- test_destroy_mesh test_destroy_material test_destroy_texture test_destroy_skeleton test_double_destroy_safe test_destroy_unowned_safe test_default_textures_preserved test_mesh_count_create_destroy_sequence test_material_count_create_destroy_sequence test_destroy_api_compiles
